title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

title: Solution Architect
description:
AudioCodes is currently looking for a Solution Architect to develop productive partner relationships and turn joint account plans into sustainable commercial growth.
   

  

 The role combines practical expertise in channel sales and partner account management with close collaboration across regional Sales, presales specialists, Marketing and the partner ecosystem.
   

  

 About Us:
   

  

 We are AudioCodes, (NASDAQ: AUDC) a global leader in voice communications, voice AI, Unified Communications, Contact Center, and AI\-powered customer experience solutions. For over 30 years, we have helped enterprises and service providers worldwide modernize their communications environments and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences.
   

  

 As a trusted Microsoft partner and a leader in Voice AI and Conversational AI, AudioCodes enables organizations to accelerate digital transformation through innovative solutions that integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and other leading collaboration platforms.
   

  

 With a global presence, thousands of customers worldwide, and a strong ecosystem of partners, AudioCodes is recognized as a market leader in enterprise communications and AI\-driven voice solutions.
   

  

 Your mission:
   

  

 As our
 **Solution Architect** 
 , you will develop productive partner relationships and turn joint account plans into sustainable commercial growth, taking responsibility for the work and decisions that make this possible.
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day work will combine partner account planning, opportunity reviews, enablement sessions and direct conversations about customer needs, with a clear link between each activity and the outcome it is intended to achieve.
   

  

 You will own the journey from partner recruitment and onboarding through joint opportunity development, execution and ongoing account growth, making sure important details and commitments carry through each stage.
   

  

 Working closely with regional Sales, presales specialists, Marketing and the partner ecosystem, you will clarify expectations, coordinate dependencies and bring the right expertise into decisions at the right time.
   

  

 You will use your professional judgment to investigate challenges, evaluate practical options and explain the implications of your recommendations to the people involved.
   

  

 You will keep priorities, progress and risks visible, maintaining useful documentation and agreeing concrete next steps when circumstances or requirements change.
   

  

 The role requires direct involvement in execution, curiosity about the underlying problems and a willingness to improve working practices using feedback and observed results.
   

  

 Your contribution will be reflected in the quality of partner engagement, joint pipeline progression and the business delivered through those relationships, as well as the trust and effective working relationships you build across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop partner account plans with clear priorities, joint activities and measurable commercial outcomes.
* Identify and qualify new channel partners and build a productive onboarding and enablement plan.
* Work with partners to identify customer opportunities, map stakeholders and agree actionable next steps.
* Coordinate with presales and Marketing to deliver relevant enablement, campaigns and customer engagements.
* Manage commercial discussions and help partners progress opportunities through to a clear buying decision.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, account plans and opportunity forecasts, escalating risks early.


 Requirements:
   

  

**Professional Requirements**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in pre\-sales solution architecture, channel sales, and partner account management — Mandatory
* A record of both conducting POC's, Demo's, RFP's and developing channel partners and growing commercially productive accounts — Mandatory
* ﻿Proven experience selling to the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services \& Insurance) vertical, with direct exposure to enterprise customers in this sector \- Mandatory
* Ability to build joint business plans and translate them into qualified customer opportunities — Mandatory
* Experience navigating enterprise buying processes and working with multiple decision makers — Mandatory
* Practical commercial negotiation, account planning and opportunity management skills — Mandatory
* Practical experience with UCaaS, Voice AI, Microsoft Teams, Genesys, Avaya, Zoom, AWS, Azure and the ability to apply this knowledge to the role's core activities — Mandatory


**Soft Skills**
* Strong written and spoken English, active listening and clear communication with different stakeholders — Mandatory
* Independent ownership, sound prioritization and effective collaboration across teams — Mandatory


**Advantages**
* Experience developing a new partner territory or building a channel program from an early stage — Advantage
* Experience coordinating joint marketing campaigns and measuring their contribution to pipeline — Advantage
* Experience expanding an existing account into additional products, use cases, or business units — Advantage

title: Solutions Architect - Insurance Domain
description:

 Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for the Claims Platform for large, global insurers across Life and Health insurance lines. This role is responsible for ensuring the  platform is implemented correctly, integrated effectively within complex insurer  ecosystems, and successfully taken from discovery through production go\-live. 
 



 The Solution Architect acts as the single point of architectural ownership across  customer stakeholders, internal product teams, delivery teams, implementation  partners, and third\-party vendors. 
 



 This is not a purely advisory or remote architecture role. The expectation is that the  individual has operated on the ground, worked closely with insurers during critical  implementation phases, handled ambiguity, and made real\-time decisions during UAT,  cutover, and go\-live. 
 



**Core Responsibilities** 




**1\. International On\-Site Implementation Ownership (Mandatory)** 




 • Must have prior experience travelling internationally for enterprise insurance  platform implementations. 
 



 • Must have led implementations on\-site from requirements gathering through  solution design, UAT, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare. 
 



 • Serve as the primary architectural authority during customer engagements and  represent the product confidently in front of senior stakeholders. 
 



 • Work closely with: 
 



 o Claims business teams 
 



 o Operations teams 
 



 o Customer IT, architecture, and security teams 
 



 o System integrators 
 



 o Third\-party vendors and external partners 
 



 • Drive workshops to understand current\-state processes, future\-state  requirements, gaps, and dependencies. 
 



 • Convert business requirements into practical, scalable solution designs while  balancing product capability versus customer\-specific customisation. • Handle ambiguity during discovery phases and bring structure to incomplete or  evolving requirements. 
 



 • Make real\-time decisions during testing, cutover, and production support  situations. 
 



 • Support high\-pressure go\-live activities, defect triage, business escalations, and  hypercare. 
 



 • Ensure customer confidence through strong communication, ownership, and  decisive problem\-solving. 
 



  





**2\. Enterprise Integration Ownership** 




  





 • Own end\-to\-end integration architecture between the Claims Platform  and the insurer ecosystem. 
 



 • Hands\-on experience integrating claims solutions with: 
 



 o Policy Administration Systems 
 



 o CRM and omni\-channel platforms 
 



 o Document Management Systems (DMS) 
 



 o Payment and finance systems 
 



 o External provider, hospital, TPA, and regulatory ecosystems 
 



 o Customer communication platforms such as SMS, email, portals, and  contact centres 
 



 • Define and drive the overall API and integration strategy for customer  implementations. 
 



 • Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns across upstream  and downstream systems. 
 



 • Own error handling, retry mechanisms, exception management, reconciliation,  and operational monitoring for integrations. 
 



 • Ensure end\-to\-end data consistency and transaction integrity across multiple  systems. 
 



 • Work with customer enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure the  solution fits within the broader insurer landscape. 
 



 • Support data mapping, interface specifications, payload definitions, and  integration testing. 
 



 • Provide architectural guidance on performance, dependency management, and  system interoperability. 
 



  





**3\. Claims Product \& Domain Mastery** 




 • Demonstrate deep expertise in Life and Health claims processes and operating  models. 
 



 • Strong understanding of: 
 



 o Pre\-authorisation workflows 
 



 o Reimbursement and cashless claims 
 



 o Auto\-adjudication and manual assessment flows 
 



 o Claims intake and registration 
 



 o Medical coding and clinical pathways 
 



 o Provider and hospital workflows 
 



 o Claims payment, settlement, and recovery 
 



 o Fraud, Waste, and Abuse controls 
 



 o Claims correspondence and communication processes 
 



 • Guide customers on how to use the platform effectively rather than over customising it. 
 



 • Identify where customer requirements can be solved through product  configuration versus custom development. 
 



 • Ensure solution designs align with industry best practices and support  operational efficiency. 
 



 • Understand the broader impact of claims processes on customer experience,  operational teams, provider networks, and downstream finance systems.
 



  





 • Be able to challenge customer requests when they introduce  unnecessary complexity, operational risk, or deviation from the product  roadmap. 
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by combining deep claims  knowledge with practical implementation experience. 
 



  





**Experience Profile** 




 • 12\+ years of total experience 
 



 • 2\- 4\+ years of experience specifically in Life and Health Claims platforms • Proven experience leading international, on\-site insurance implementations • Strong exposure to APAC, EMEA, or other global insurer environments • Experience working across complex insurer IT landscapes and multiple  stakeholder groups 
 



 • Hands\-on involvement in large\-scale implementations, production go\-lives, and  hypercare 
 



 • Strong ability to work across business, technology, and delivery teams • Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes under pressure 
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Smooth and predictable go\-lives with minimal escalations 
 



 • Strong confidence and trust from customer CIOs, Heads of Claims, and  business leadership teams

 • Delivery teams aligned to a product\-first implementation approach • Clear architectural decisions with minimal ambiguity or rework • Faster implementation cycles with reduced delivery risk 
 


* • Reduced dependency on founders and senior leadership for delivery assurance • Customers viewing the individual as a trusted advisor rather than only a  technical architect

title: Director, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
 Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing businesses within Aladdin and represents a significant strategic investment for BlackRock. The team builds and operates the technology platforms that power accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Our engineers develop business\-critical application, data, reporting, and workflow systems while driving modernization through distributed architectures, advanced data platforms, and engineering innovation. Working closely with Product, Operations, Data, and Engineering partners, the team delivers capabilities that support BlackRock and the broader Aladdin client ecosystem.
   

  

**Your role and impact**
 As an Engineering Director, Application Engineering, you will serve as a senior technology leader responsible for shaping architecture, engineering strategy, and delivery across enterprise\-scale platforms supporting global post\-trade operations. You will connect long\-term technology vision with pragmatic execution, influence critical technical decisions, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders. This role combines deep technical expertise with organizational leadership, enabling you to drive modernization, improve platform resiliency, and deliver meaningful business outcomes at scale.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and drive technology strategy, target\-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader Aladdin strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps, leading modernization initiatives and balancing technical debt reduction with delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade\-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.


**Your Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 12 years of demonstrated leadership experience across enterprise\-scale software engineering environments.
* Deep expertise in modern application architecture, distributed systems, microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), event\-driven architectures, and enterprise software design.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise application development and data architecture, including large\-scale processing, data modeling, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience designing and operating large\-scale application and data platforms using modern messaging, caching, and distributed processing approaches.
* Demonstrated success defining technology strategy, leading complex multi\-team initiatives, and balancing modernization investments with delivery objectives.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision\-making, risk management, reliability, security, and operational excellence capabilities within business\-critical environments.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM) concepts, cloud\-native platforms, observability technologies, automation frameworks, and regulated financial\-services environments.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
Platform FDE
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 About GreyLabs AI
 



 GreyLabs AI is building an enterprise\-grade Voice AI platform for the BFSI ecosystem. Our technology enables banks, insurers, NBFCs and financial\-services organizations to automate and humanize customer conversations across collections, sales, customer service and compliance.
 



 We are looking for a highly execution\-oriented Program Manager who understands how Generative AI applications are built and can translate real business requirements into effective AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is not a traditional project\-coordination role. You will work hands\-on with prompts, conversation flows, agent logic, integrations and testing while owning the execution of client\-facing AI programs.
 



 You will take use cases from requirement discovery and solution design through prototyping, implementation, testing and production rollout. The ideal candidate is curious about how AI systems behave, enjoys experimenting with prompts and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI Agent and Prompt Development
 


* Design, write and optimize prompts for AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
* Convert business requirements into structured conversational flows, agent instructions, decision logic and guardrails.
* Build and configure AI agents capable of performing tasks, using tools, calling APIs and managing multi\-step conversations.
* Develop prompt frameworks covering personas, objectives, context, constraints, fallback handling and escalation logic.
* Test prompts across multiple scenarios, edge cases, customer personas, languages and conversation paths.
* Analyse agent failures, hallucinations and inconsistent responses, and continuously improve performance.
* Create evaluation frameworks and test datasets to measure accuracy, task completion, compliance and conversation quality.



 Program Execution
 


* Own AI implementation programs from discovery and POC to deployment and production go\-live.
* Create execution plans, define milestones and manage dependencies across clients, product, engineering and operations teams.
* Conduct client discussions to understand business processes and recommend suitable AI\-led workflows.
* Translate client requirements into clear product configurations, user stories and implementation documents.
* Coordinate API integrations, data requirements, UAT, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Track deliverables closely and proactively address delays, blockers and execution risks.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
* Take ownership of issues until they are completely resolved.



 Voice AI and Conversational Experience
 


* Design natural and outcome\-oriented conversations for voice and chat channels.
* Configure conversation flows for use cases such as customer service, sales, collections, lead qualification and customer onboarding.
* Work with concepts such as intent recognition, entity extraction, context retention, interruption handling, fallback responses and human\-agent handoffs.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations involving LLMs, APIs, ASR, TTS, telephony and enterprise systems.
* Review conversation transcripts and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 1–3 years of experience in AI implementation, program management, product operations, solutions, conversational AI or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI tools.
* Demonstrable experience building or configuring at least one AI agent, voice agent, chatbot or LLM\-powered workflow.
* Understanding of LLM concepts such as system prompts, few\-shot prompting, structured outputs, tool or function calling, context management and hallucination control.
* Ability to independently test, troubleshoot and improve AI\-generated responses.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks and system integrations.
* Strong execution discipline with the ability to drive projects from idea to production.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work from our Mumbai office.



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Experience with agent\-building or workflow platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Retell AI, Vapi or similar tools.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-source LLM APIs.
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, knowledge bases and multi\-agent workflows.
* Experience with voice technologies, including speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech or telephony integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, BFSI, fintech or customer\-service automation.
* Basic proficiency in Python, SQL or low\-code automation platforms.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients.



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Independently convert a business use case into a working AI\-agent workflow.
* Create prompts, conversation logic, guardrails and comprehensive test scenarios.
* Manage a client implementation from requirements gathering to go\-live.
* Identify agent\-performance issues and improve outcomes through structured experimentation.
* Deliver multiple AI programs with speed, ownership and attention to detail.



 Who Will Thrive in This Role
 



 You will be a strong fit if you:
 


* Prefer building and executing over only creating plans and trackers.
* Experiment with AI tools beyond your formal responsibilities.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technology.
* Combine structured program management with hands\-on problem\-solving.
* Take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Are excited by the opportunity to build production\-grade AI agents for large enterprises.

**Job Description / Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. * Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.

* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.

* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.

 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
 **a hands\-on senior technical architect** 
 on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
   

  

 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
   

  

 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
   

  

 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Customer\-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud \& DevOps: Hands\-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.

title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
description:

 .

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.

* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.

description:
**About Company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in data management, MDM, data architecture
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Master Data Management experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with Profisee MDM is mandatory
* Prior experience reviewing, troubleshooting, stabilising or optimizing an existing Profisee implementation is highly desirable



  





**Required Technical Experience** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Hands\-on Profisee implementation experience
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Profisee
* Strong understanding of Profisee architecture and implementation patterns
* Experience with Profisee data models, matching, merging, survivorship and workflows
* Experience analysing Profisee integrations and downstream data flows
* Strong understanding of MDM data quality and governance
* Experience working with complex enterprise integration landscapes



**Desirable:** 



* Azure / Microsoft Fabric / Microsoft Purview experience
* Experience with APIs and integration platforms
* Experience with ERP/CRM environments such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle or similar
* Experience with data stewardship and operating\-model design
* Experience conducting MDM health checks, architecture reviews or implementation assessments



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 The successful candidate will:
 



**1\. Current\-State Assessment** 



* Review the existing Profisee implementation, architecture and configuration
* Understand the current MDM operating model, business processes and ownership
* Document key challenges, impacted business processes and manual workarounds
* Review how master data is created, changed, approved, mastered and distributed
* Assess the current roles and responsibilities across business, data stewardship, technology and support teams



**2\. Profisee Implementation Review** 



* Assess whether the Profisee implementation is appropriately designed for the organisation's business requirements
* Identify areas of unnecessary complexity, over\-engineering or configuration that may be contributing to operational issues
* Review Profisee data models, entities, attributes, relationships and hierarchies
* Review matching, merging and survivorship configuration
* Review workflows, stewardship processes, validation rules and business rules
* Assess whether configuration follows Profisee implementation best practices
* Identify configuration/design issues that may impact data quality or downstream processing



**3\. Integration \& Data Flow Review** 



* Review the end\-to\-end integration architecture surrounding Profisee
* Trace critical data flows from source systems through Profisee to downstream applications
* Investigate issues associated with incorrect or unexpected data updates reaching downstream systems
* Assess interfaces, APIs, integration services, event/batch mechanisms and transformation logic
* Identify potential issues around data ownership, change propagation, sequencing, dependencies and error handling
* Assess monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling and support processes
* Recommend improvements to integration patterns and controls



**4\. Data Migration \& Data Quality Assessment** 



* Assess the approach used to migrate data into Profisee
* Evaluate the organisation's confidence in migrated master data
* Identify gaps in reconciliation, validation and data\-quality controls
* Review DQ rules, thresholds and validation logic
* Assess whether current DQ controls are overly restrictive or generating unnecessary operational effort
* Recommend a pragmatic approach to balancing data quality, business usability and operational efficiency

title: Staff Data Architect
description:
****This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office****
 Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 As a Staff Data Architect for Customer Growth, you will be the technical beacon and architectural anchor for the data ecosystems that drive our customer acquisition, retention, and engagement strategies. This is a high\-impact, leadership\-by\-influence role where you will not just write code, but design the future\-proof frameworks that empower multiple engineering squads.
   

  

 You will evaluate complex technical trade\-offs, champion engineering excellence, and foster a culture of innovation. Operating across the entire Customer Growth portfolio, you will collaborate closely with product management, data science, and business leaders to turn massive datasets into strategic growth levers.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Get To**
* Architecture \& Framework Design: Design, build, and evolve robust, scalable, and highly reliable data architectures and framework\-level designs that support real\-time personalization, marketing automation, and advanced customer analytics.
* Technical Decision Making \& Trade\-off Analysis: Act as the ultimate sounding board for complex data challenges. Evaluate competing technologies and methodologies (e.g., batch vs. streaming, self\-hosted vs. managed services, various data lakehouse architectures) and present objective, clear trade\-off analyses to stakeholders.
* Best Practices \& Governance: Define, document, and evangelize global engineering best practices, data governance frameworks, security standards, and CI/CD automation patterns across the portfolio.
* Cross\-Portfolio Collaboration: Break down silos. Work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams within the Customer Growth domain to ensure data infrastructure aligns perfectly with product roadmaps and business goals.
* Innovation \& R\&D: Stay ahead of the curve. Continually research, prototype, and introduce emerging technologies and innovative paradigms (such as Data Mesh, advanced identity resolution, or real\-time feature stores) to keep our growth engine competitive.
* Mentorship \& Technical Guidance: Act as a force multiplier. Guide, unblock, and elevate senior and mid\-level engineers by conducting rigorous code/architecture reviews and hosting knowledge\-sharing sessions.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience designing and implementing distributed data processing systems utilizing tools like Apache Spark, Flink, Kafka, or Delta Lake/Iceberg.
* Deep expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud\-native data warehousing solutions like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Proven track record of building reusable data libraries, custom tooling, or internal platforms that accelerated development for other engineering teams.
* Expert\-level knowledge of data modeling paradigms (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema) tailored for complex customer journeys and behavioral data.
* Highly proficient in Python, Scala, or Java, alongside expert\-level SQL.
* A natural curiosity to challenge the status quo and a history of successfully introducing innovative data solutions to business problems.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical business partners, and a proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to look at multiple viable technical paths, weigh the immediate business needs against long\-term technical debt, and confidently steer the team toward the optimal choice.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential


**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
   

  

**Perks \& Benefits At Priceline**
 Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
   

  

**Health \& wellness coverage** 
 including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
   

  

**Generous time off** 
 including PTO, holidays, a company\-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
   

  

**Work/life support** 
 including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
   

  

**Financial security programs** 
 such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax\-advantaged accounts
   

  

**Signature travel perks** 
 including employee\-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
   

  

**Additional perks \& discounts** 
 like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
   

  

**A people\-first culture** 
 with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
   

  

*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
 To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
   

  

 Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

title: Process Engineer - AI Automation & Business Process Management
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA** 




  





 Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
 



 AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
 



  





 CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognized for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 



  





 AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
 



  





**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)** 




  





 At AMINA India, we are looking for an experienced professional to lead end‑to‑end process discovery, redesign, and AI\-driven automation across critical business functions, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact. The role also champions compliant, well\-governed solutions while driving adoption through close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering sustainable, high\-value transformation.
 



  





**Your AMINA To\-Do List** 




  





**Discover, map and redesign processes** 



* Run process\-discovery workshops with teams across compliance, onboarding, operations, treasury, and client services.
* Produce clear, accurate process maps (BPMN or equivalent) and document the inputs, decisions, controls, and hand\-offs in each workflow.
* Redesign and optimize the process at hand, preparing it for potential automation / AI integration
* Identify automation candidates and quantify the opportunity — FTE saved, cycle\-time reduction, error\-rate impact, and cost.



**Design and build AI\-driven automation** 



* Translate process pain points into automation solutions using LLM\-based workflows, integration platforms, and APIs.
* Build, test, and iterate on automations — from document extraction and drafting assistants to alert triage, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Engineer reliable prompts and pipelines, design the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and evaluate AI output quality with real test sets rather than vibes.
* Track token usage, run\-cost, and ROI per initiative, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and model\-selection decisions.



**Keep it compliant and governed** 



* Design every automation so the accountable human still owns the decision — especially in regulated processes (KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, reporting).
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and IT to ensure solutions meet control, audit, data\-protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation, change logs, and a clear inventory of what's automated, who owns it, and how it's monitored.



**Drive adoption** 



* Partner with business owners to pilot, refine, and roll out automations — and to get genuine buy\-in, not shelfware.
* Build internal momentum for AI adoption in a risk\-aware environment, navigating IT and security gatekeeping constructively.
* Train users, write SOPs, and hand over solutions in a maintainable state.



  





**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:** 




  




* 4–10 years of experience in Business Process Management, Process Improvement, Automation, or Operational Transformation.
* Proven experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes using structured methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma, Process Mining).
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements\-gathering skills across business and technical teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and workflow automation tools, including LLMs, APIs, and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier).
* Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and implementation of appropriate controls and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages and data analysis.
* Experience within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of financial\-services processes such as KYC, AML, onboarding, payments, reconciliation, or regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of risk, controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach and the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.



 Preferred
 


* Experience with crypto, digital assets, or blockchain\-related processes.
* Familiarity with FINMA, MiCA, AML, or similar regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with RAG, AI assistants, agentic workflows, Process Mining, or RPA tools. German language skills are a plus.



  





**Why We’re Awesome** 




  





 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
 **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!** 




  





 Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Solution Architect)
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Worley is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and deliver integrated digital, OT, IT, data, application, infrastructure, integration, and security architectures for major industrial programs. The role will translate business and operational objectives into practical solution designs, architecture artefacts, integration models, and implementation\-ready guidance supporting procurement, vendor assessment, FEED delivery, and project execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong architecture capability, practical IT/OT integration experience, cybersecurity\-by\-design awareness, and the ability to align client, engineering, vendor, and delivery stakeholders around secure, scalable, and operationally maintainable outcomes.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Develop solution architectures across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, OT, IT, and security domains, ensuring alignment with client reference models and delivery\-phase requirements.
* Translate enterprise architecture, business objectives, and operational requirements into actionable solution designs that guide procurement, vendor assessment, implementation planning, and project execution.
* Produce implementation\-focused architecture artefacts, including system context diagrams, logical and physical architecture views, integration models, infrastructure deployment views, network segmentation concepts, platform deployment views, application interface definitions, and architecture decision records.
* Define integration and interoperability models across industrial levels 1\-4, including OT/IT convergence, edge/cloud hybrid deployments, data exchange patterns, secure connectivity, and segmented network architectures.
* Apply architecture governance to ensure solutions meet client standards, engineering requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable industrial frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISA\-95, OPC UA, MQTT, and other relevant integration patterns.
* Collaborate with internal and client\-side stakeholders, including OT, IT, cybersecurity, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, project delivery, vendors, and system integrators, to gather requirements, validate assumptions, and coordinate architecture inputs.
* Support traceability of business, operational, functional, non\-functional, and technical requirements through architecture artefacts and requirements management tools.

description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.
